_readme: Known-answer vector corpus for Argon2id. Every entry is externally sourced;
none were generated by this repository's own engine, so a silent divergence
in the underlying implementation fails these tests loudly.
tagVectors: raw inputs + expected tag bytes, checked against the engine
directly. Entries without secret/associatedData are additionally assembled
into a PHC string and verified through the library's public API.
phcStringVectors: verbatim PHC strings emitted by other ecosystems,
verified through the public API only.

tagVectors.source: RFC 9106, section 5.3 (Argon2id test vector; includes secret key and associated data)
Official Argon2 reference C implementation via argon2-cffi 25.1.0 (ARGON2_VERSION=0x13); same vector pinned in PhcInteropTests

phcStringVectors.source: argon2-cffi 25.1.0 (reference-C libargon2), UTF-8 password with non-ASCII + astral codepoint
